statistical_notes: All current trials report target interface B failure, with no competing-interface censoring.
One printed sample per E31 design, one latest trial each: do not infer force ratios or design causation.
Top-side E31 studs are identical CAD geometry; measured 5–7 inclusive, reflecting combined printed-unit and test variability.
Earlier and latest bottom-protocol differences may be explained by counting-convention change (uniform offset 1) and/or subjective shaking strength.
Maximum surviving count is a discrete ordinal test score, not force or directly comparable across different assembly geometries.
safety: Adult-only trial coupons. Split tube, beads and failure debris require fatigue and child safety verification separately.
